input: Teach myself touch typing using a free online tool

gold.taskTitle: Teach Myself Touch Typing With Free Tool
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to independently learn touch typing from scratch using a free online resource.

questions.title: What is your current typing speed in words per minute?
questions.description: Understanding the user's baseline skill level helps set a realistic starting point and measure progress.

questions.title: What typing speed are you aiming to reach?
questions.description: Knowing the target WPM or accuracy goal helps define what success looks like for this task.

questions.title: How many minutes per day can you dedicate to practice?
questions.description: Daily time availability determines how the practice schedule should be structured.

questions.title: By what date do you want to achieve your typing goal?
questions.description: A deadline helps pace the learning plan and set weekly milestones.

questions.title: Do you type mostly on a laptop or a desktop keyboard?
questions.description: Keyboard type can affect technique and which tools or finger placement guides are most relevant.

questions.title: Do you have a specific free tool in mind already?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user already has a preferred platform avoids recommending tools they have already ruled out.

questions.title: Is improving accuracy or speed your bigger priority right now?
questions.description: The answer shapes whether the plan emphasizes deliberate slow practice or speed-building drills first.
